likelihood_concentration.note: eta = 1 likelihood concentration: the importance weights the untempered likelihood would give the prior draws. With thousands of scored cells and a stochastic likelihood they are expected to collapse to an ESS of about 1 whatever the fit, so these numbers measure how sharply the raw likelihood ranks the draws. They are not a fit or convergence diagnostic, and no posterior is built from them.
